purpose: Evidence packet only. The set records explicit official rules for five additional airlines. Each recommendation remains subject to the route, carrier and space conditions stated by the airline.

provenance_defaults.reviewer: Codex — lecture directe de la page officielle

facts.condition_scope: official ceiling applies to animal plus carrier; service availability is limited by flight and must be checked during booking
facts.finder_effect: For a 30 or 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable. At or below 8 kg dog body weight alone is not a positive clearance.
facts.quote: The weight of the animal transported in the cabin together with the container may not exceed 8 kg.
facts.locator: An animal in the cabin → Transport of an animal on board

facts.condition_scope: service must be checked during booking; container, destination and aircraft restrictions apply
facts.finder_effect: Passenger hold can be proposed conditionally; do not present it as automatically available for the itinerary.
facts.quote: Check the availability of the service by booking your ticket on lot.com or later, up to 12 hours before departure, in Manage My Booking.
facts.locator: Animal in the baggage hold → opening information

facts.condition_scope: the official rule covers listed brachycephalic dogs and crossbreeds/animals with brachycephalic characteristics
facts.finder_effect: For a listed brachycephalic dog, do not offer LOT passenger hold. Do not generalise the refusal to cargo or cabin without their separate conditions.
facts.quote: we have decided to prohibit the transport of brachycephalic dog and cat breeds in the aircraft’s baggage hold.
facts.locator: Animal in the baggage hold → Information about the transport of brachycephalic breeds

facts.condition_scope: LOT Cargo transports live animals through shipping companies; requirements and charges must be established with the selected shipper
facts.finder_effect: Cargo may be offered conditionally, not promised: the visitor must be directed to the required shipping-company process.
facts.quote: LOT Cargo provides air transport services for live animals on domestic, European, and intercontinental flights.
facts.locator: Transport of animals as cargo in the baggage hold → Travel as cargo

facts.condition_scope: the 8 kg limit includes a soft carrier and assistance dogs are a separate regime
facts.finder_effect: For a 30 or 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable. At or below 8 kg, carrier, route and space availability remain conditions.
facts.quote: Dogs and cats weighing up to 8 kg (weight including travel carrier)
facts.locator: Travelling with animals → The following animals can travel in the cabin

facts.condition_scope: only non-snub-nosed dogs/cats over 8 kg or exceeding cabin-carrier size; country and airport rules may require cargo or forbid carriage
facts.finder_effect: For a large non-brachycephalic dog, passenger hold may be offered under the official route and carrier conditions.
facts.quote: Dogs and cats that do not belong to snub-nosed breeds and weigh more than 8 kg (weight including transport container)
facts.locator: Travelling with animals → The following animals travel in the hold

facts.condition_scope: snub-nosed/brachycephalic dogs are accepted in cabin only and are not approved for hold carriage
facts.finder_effect: Do not offer SWISS passenger hold for a brachycephalic dog; separately assess cabin size and route conditions.
facts.quote: Snub-nosed (brachycephalic) breeds are only accepted in the cabin

facts.condition_scope: the 8 kg ceiling includes the carrier; some countries require freight irrespective of size
facts.finder_effect: For a 30 or 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable. At or below 8 kg dog body weight alone, retain carrier and destination checks.
facts.quote: The total weight of the animal and the carrying container must not exceed 8 kg.
facts.locator: Travelling with animals → Small pets in the cabin

facts.condition_scope: carrier size and weight are supplied at booking, aircraft loading/space is checked, and some destinations do not accept large animals in the hold
facts.finder_effect: Passenger hold may be proposed conditionally; it must not be presented as a confirmed booking result.
facts.quote: cats and dogs may be carried in the cargo hold if required, subject to compliance with the applicable conditions of carriage.
facts.locator: Travelling with animals → Large animals in the cargo hold

facts.condition_scope: the rule is breed-based for snub-nosed/brachycephalic dogs and cats
facts.finder_effect: Do not offer Austrian passenger hold for a brachycephalic dog; cabin and freight are separate questions.
facts.quote: cats and dogs belonging to snub-nosed (brachycephalic) breeds are not permitted in the hold

facts.condition_scope: official ceiling applies to pet plus carrier; carrier, availability and destination requirements remain mandatory
facts.finder_effect: For a 30 or 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable. A smaller dog still needs a compliant carrier and pre-confirmed pet space.
facts.locator: Travelling with pets → Small pets in cabin

facts.condition_scope: up to 75 kg pet plus crate; routes to/from Amsterdam are capped at 39 kg, and space must be confirmed in advance
facts.finder_effect: Passenger hold may be proposed for a large dog only with the actual crate, route and airline confirmation; the Amsterdam cap is material.
facts.locator: Travelling with pets → Large pets in cargo hold

facts.condition_scope: the threshold is pet plus crate; airBaltic directs over-75 kg cases to cargo
facts.finder_effect: Do not offer passenger hold above 75 kg combined; direct the visitor to airBaltic Cargo conditions.
facts.quote: over 75 kg: must go as cargo
facts.locator: Travelling with pets → Large pets in cargo hold

facts.condition_scope: the limit applies to dog/cat plus carrier, capacity requires prior confirmation, and the UK, UAE and Qatar are excluded on the directly read page
facts.finder_effect: For a 30 or 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable. At or below 8 kg dog body weight alone, carrier, route and confirmation remain required.
facts.quote: the weight of the pet together with the carrier (maximum 8 kg)
facts.locator: Traveling with your pets → booking the service

intentionally_unset.reason: The directly read current Air Serbia passenger page establishes the cabin service; this cohort does not include an equally current direct hold rule.
No directly read current official Air Serbia source in this cohort establishes an ordinary pet-dog cargo service.
The directly read Austrian source gives destination-specific freight requirements but does not establish a general ordinary pet-dog cargo product.
The source identifies destinations that require cargo but does not establish a general positive cargo service for the specific dog, crate and route.
